question: Which new sketch constraint did Onshape add in its October 30, 2026 update?
answer: Based on Onshape's "Improvements to Onshape - October 30, 2026" release [3], the new sketch constraint is the Flow constraint for G3 continuity [3]. It makes position, tangency, curvature, and the rate of change of curvature all match where two curves join [3]. It builds on the existing Tangent (G1) and Curvature (G2) constraints and is aimed at class-A transitions for consumer products, automotive surfaces, and motion paths [3].
